en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Every place which can be entered without permission of its owner, so a thief steals from it, so there would be no cutting upon him, meaning the (public) baths, and the hotels, and the resting places’.
